name: Saegusa Nanako
source:
An older sister figure who works at the café where the protagonist is employed.

A mood-maker who lightens the atmosphere with her perfect blend of humor and wit, she always takes the time to comfort the protagonist at the end of a tough, exhausting workday.

Handling both the kitchen and the floor, she’s essentially the backbone that keeps the café running.

“Huh!? Why me!? But… thank you…”
